sectors.name: Riverside cabins
sectors.rationale: Occupied single-story buildings in the projected flood extent. The access road has no recent field verification.
sectors.next: Verify occupancy and the west access road before assigning a rescue approach.
sectors.uncertainty: Occupancy is an area-level estimate. Water depth and access are simulated, not measured.

evidence.label: Water across the west access road
Low ground may isolate cabin entrances

sectors.name: South Fork residences
sectors.rationale: Reports describe isolated residences. Tributary inflow is uncertain and there is no recent access check.
sectors.next: Request a reconnaissance report on access and assistance needs.
sectors.uncertainty: Reports are unverified. Counts represent a mock range, not confirmed victims.

sectors.name: River Road crossing
sectors.rationale: The crossing connects two search sectors. A verified closure changes access for both teams.
sectors.next: Use the alternate approach and verify its status before travel.
sectors.uncertainty: Confirmed describes the fixture’s evidence state only. No real closure is asserted.

sectors.name: East-bank neighborhood
sectors.rationale: No recent reports from an exposed neighborhood. Verifying this gap would improve downstream planning.
sectors.next: Check access, occupancy, and local water conditions.
sectors.uncertainty: No report does not mean the area is clear.

sectors.name: Downstream staging
sectors.rationale: The last access report is older than the exercise freshness threshold. Verify before moving resources.
sectors.next: Request a fresh approach and staging-capacity report.
sectors.uncertainty: An old clear report cannot establish current passability.
